(1)Printing and Supply of Rail Travel Coupon (RTC) Book for the Member for the Maharashtra Legislature Se cretariat, for 8000 nos books Within the State & for 2000 nos books Outside the State of Maharashtra. (2) All books are required to be printed with serial number (book no.). i.e. for 2000 books each book will re quire to be printed separate serial number commencing from M009001A to M011000A (2000 Books). Num bering is to be printed with mechanical numbering only. Electronic number printing is not acceptable. (3) All books are required to be printed with serial number (book no.). i.e. for 8000 books each book will re quire to be printed separate serial number commencing from M008001 to M016000 (8000 Books). Number ing is to be printed with mechanical numbering only. Electronic number printing is not acceptable. (4)Sample/specification is attached in the ATC document. (5)Sample should be approved by the consignee before bulk supply of material. (6) Past Performance: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through re-seller(s)} should have supplied the same or similar Category Products for 20% of the bid quantity, in at least one of the last three Financial ye ars and the current FY before the bid opening date to any Central / State Govt Organisation / PSU / Public L isted Company. Copies of relevant contracts (proving supply of cumulative order quantity in any one finan cial year) to be submitted along with bid in support of quantity supplied in the relevant Financial year. (7) Para-wise compliance for specifications/conditions mentioned in both spec sheets upload as additional customisation is mandatory; otherwise, the offer will be summarily rejected. (8) The printing of coupon pages is mandatory on the IR logo security watermark paper. (9) Full safety and security of printed coupon books and dies, etc., should be ensured by the printing press ; otherwise, any violation in this regard may attract legal and blacklist action against the bidder as well as the printing press. (10) Presence in the pre-bid meeting at the prescribed time and venue is mandatory; otherwise, their offer may be summarily rejected. (11) No. of Pages per item mentioned in the additional requirement of the bid document excludes the top e nd cover page. (12) The printer shall ensure strict control over the printing, numbering, accounting, custody and delivery of the coupon books. (13) The entire quantity printed shall be duly accounted for, and any spoiled, defective or excess printed c oupons shall be recorded and handed over to the Railway for verification and disposal as per instructions. (14) The supply shall be accepted only after verification of the prescribed serial numbers and quantities by the nominated Railway officials. . 7.
